title: About Me
content:
I am an Economics and Statistics student at Chuka University building a career in Data Science. I use Python, SQL, Excel, Power BI, and machine learning to analyze data and generate meaningful insights.

Beyond my studies, I have trained learners in foundational Data Science, data handling, and Microsoft Excel, helping them develop practical analytical skills.

My projects include FinSight AI, a behavioral credit-scoring framework for African micro-entrepreneurs, and Resilience Capital, a climate-adaptive lending concept. I also secured 3rd place at the SEKU Regional Data Science Hackathon for a building-age classification project using satellite data.

I am continuously developing my skills through practical projects and independent learning, with interests in Data Analytics, Machine Learning and Economic Research.
